data.long_meaning: Ermentrude is a Germanic name derived from the elements erm (strong) and trud (counsel). The name means 'strong in counsel' or 'famous in battle'. Ermentrude was a popular name among the Franks and the Merovingians, and was borne by several notable women in medieval Europe.
